messages.text: Good call on leaving when the line started wrapping around the door.
Yeah, I got exactly enough outside time and eggs before the Sunday crowd got loud.
Also thank you for not letting me order a second round just because grading is rude.
One was plenty. I was not trying to lose the rest of my afternoon.
Pastor Reed asked where you disappeared to after the last song yesterday.
Had to get over to campus and finish comments before class prep swallowed the whole day.
Mm. He said tell you he was glad to see you in the pew again.
Tell him I said thanks. I'm trying to make it when I can, even if it's not every Sunday.
you up already??
heading out. sun's not even pretending yet
lol your little dawn meetup again?
yep. beach path start. back before first class stuff
fine. eat something after and don't just do coffee
Morning. Did you eat anything or are you trying to run on coffee and spite again
rude but accurate. toast now, campus later
Good. Also mom said grandma's pickup got moved to 2:30 Friday. Can you do it if I call her after class
Yeah I can. Text me after you talk to her
Mom asked again if you're bringing anybody Sunday or if she should just do your usual plate.
Just me. Same as always.
lol had to check before she started counting chairs
Tell her one chair, no booster seat situation, no extra logistics.
You up
yeah. what happened
Got a call right before I got home. Big work thing. Not bad exactly, just a lot all at once.
okay. say the whole thing first. I’m not doing solutions yet
Thank you. I just need to say it out loud before everybody starts making a plan at me.
go ahead. I’m here
Long day. You free for 10 tonight?
Yep. Call me instead of doing the vague-song-and-black-screen thing.
lol I wasn't going to post anything. Just needed your ears for a minute.
Good. Heat up food first and then call.
Are you still coming by after church Sunday?
Yeah. I need to swing home first and change after class.
Bring a sweater if you're staying for dinner. Your dad always turns the air up.
Noted. I'll be in work clothes before that anyway.
Did you see the county note about the measles cases?
Yeah. I read the county update before work.
Your grandma asked me if she needs to worry.
I told her I'd go by what Dr. Chen's office says and whatever the county posts, not random Facebook people.
Good. Send me what you find so I can tell her the same thing.
Do you still have that little hospital bracelet in the keepsake box or did it end up with the school papers
Pretty sure it's in the blue tin with the old report cards
Bring it Sunday if you can. Your grandmother wants to see the tiny Long Beach address card again before I put everything back.
Yeah I'll grab the tin tonight
Are you still coming by before dinner?
Not tonight. I have the library block with the Lincoln 11th graders after campus.
Alright. Eat something before you start because two hours is longer than you think.
I packed almonds and that sad apple from the faculty fridge.
If you're coming Sunday, tell me what you're making so I don't double up.
I'll do the pot with okra, shrimp, and sausage. And greens with smoked turkey if you want me to bring a second tray.
Bring both. Your dad will eat the greens all week if there's extra.
Stopped at Ralphs for dinner stuff and somehow left $38 lighter with just chicken thighs, spinach, garlic, one lemon, and olive oil.
That is not even a full cart.
Exactly. I kept putting things back and still got rung up like I was shopping for ten people.
Those basics add up quick out here. Come by Sunday and take leftovers home.
If you're coming Sunday, don't buy more paprika for my kitchen. I found a fresh one in the back cabinet.
Please keep it. I already did the whole spice restock at home last week and I'm not trying to start a second shelf here.
That explains why your receipt stack looked rude.
Between that and the fish run, February got out of hand. I added it up last night and landed around 450.
Did you get everything paid at the start of the month or are you still juggling it?
Got the big one out yesterday morning.
Good. The place payment?
Yeah, 1850. Hurts every time but it's done.
Done is better than dragging it. Eat something and stop looking at your account for the night.
Did the big first-of-the-month check hit yet?
Yeah, yesterday morning. I knocked out rent, power, and the phone bill before work.
Good. Do your saving transfer now too so it doesn't disappear by Sunday.
Already did. The rest has to stretch the whole month.
Your sister said you had a long night. You okay this morning?
I’m okay. I called Maya first and talked it through for a while.
Good. She’s good at letting you get it out before everybody starts telling you what to do.
Exactly. That was what I needed.
You heading out yet?
Yeah, just grabbing coffee.
Ocean gate was already backed up before 6. Took me 20 extra getting through. Leave room if you’re taking 710.
Good looking out. You on the early shift this week?
Covering dispatch till Friday. Crane crew threw the whole lineup off last night.
You coming by Sunday or no
Yeah after church stuff. Probably around 4
Alright. First pitch is 4:10 so don't stroll in at the seventh
lol I'll bring drinks and be there before then
You ever book that cleaning place by the traffic circle?
Not yet. They wanted $165 before they even did anything extra.
Mm. Call around first.
Yeah. I'm watching money this month so I pushed it.
You coming by Sunday or staying put?
I’ll come by for a bit. Keeping this week cheap so I’m not ordering anything.
Good. Eat what’s already in there first.
That’s the plan. Rice, beans, lentils, canned tomatoes. Might throw in frozen shrimp if I find the bag in the back.
You coming by Sunday or you tied up?
I should be there after I finish a few things. Need to send the rent tonight and knock out Edison + Spectrum first.
Handle your roof first. Game will still be on.
Yeah. Trying to get all the apartment stuff cleared before Friday.
Shop says that tire is done, not patchable. You good to handle it or you need me to float you till Friday?
I’m good. It’s $387 with mount/balance and I can move it over tonight.
Alright. Better than driving on it.
Yeah, I’d rather just take the hit and refill it next check.
You coming by Sunday or watching from your place
I can come through if traffic isn't wild. What's the plan
Your mom wants dinner early. First pitch is 4:10 so don't stroll in at the 3rd inning
lol understood. I'll aim for 3:30 and bring drinks
Your mom found that old Wilson track folder while clearing the hall cabinet.
The blue one with my terrible geometry notes stuffed in it?
That one. Maya wrote her name all over the back in purple marker.
She used to steal anything I left on the kitchen table.
You left everything on that table. If you want the folder, grab it Sunday when you come by.
You still setting money aside for that archive trip?
Yeah. Moved another $150 over today.
Good. Don't keep dipping into it for takeout and random stuff.
I know. It's sitting at about 1,200 now so I'm trying to leave it alone.
You still good to help Nana with the copay this month or you need me to cover it first?
I can do it after Friday. Campus deposit usually lands then.
Alright. Just keep enough for your own place.
Yeah. It’s the usual split anyway, around 4700 before everything and about 3650 once it hits.
You coming by Sunday or watching the game at your place?
Coming by after lunch. Also mailed that school board ballot today.
The one with the lady you said was good on ethnic studies and tenant stuff?
Yeah. And the other seat went to the guy the police union dumped money into, so that made it easy.
Figured you'd say that.
If you come by later, take the way past the big park. Traffic gets silly by Lakewood after lunch.
Yeah, I can cut through there from my place pretty quick. I’ll leave after my noon class lets out.
Good. You always make it over faster than your mama from that side.
Baby, church sister sent me one of those long forwarded things again. Do I need to read all that before Friday?
No, skip the chain message. I’m checking what Dr. Nguyen’s office posted and the county page instead.
Good. If they say come in, you taking me?
Yes. I’ll call after lunch once I compare their update with the CDC one.
Baby, do you need me to send extra greens home Sunday or do you still have enough room in that little fridge of yours?
Send a small container only. If I take the big one it'll block basically the whole top shelf.
Mmhm. I keep forgetting your kitchen is set up for one plate and one pot.
Exactly. Love the food, just not trying to play fridge Tetris all week.
Baby, do you still keep the extra blankets in that hall closet by your bathroom?
Yeah, top shelf. Why?
I was telling your aunt I remember when we first brought those over and your place still had boxes by the window.
Those boxes lasted way too long.
Not that long. Just feels funny that you've already been there through two summers and another winter.
Baby, do you need me to send extra greens home Sunday or do you still have enough room in that little fridge of yours?
Send a small container only. If I take the big one it'll block basically the whole top shelf.
Mmhm. I keep forgetting your kitchen is set up for one plate and one pot.
Exactly. Love the food, just not trying to play fridge Tetris all week.
Baby did you see the church anniversary pictures your aunt put online
Probably on the family site. I barely check the bird app now.
If Aunt Rene posted them where everybody leaves comments, send me that one. The blue photo app is easier for me to find things on.
I will ask Maya. I only know I pressed on your mother's page and found cousins.
You still coming Sunday? I was thinking greens, cornbread, and that baked mac your mama does right.
Yep, after church. Save me a plate if I get there late.
And remind me to tell you the story about your great-uncle riding the train out from Louisiana with one suitcase and church shoes wrapped in newspaper.
I'm recording that one this time if you're up for it.
Baby did you ever write down that line I told you after church, about your great-aunt singing while she shelled peas?
Yeah, I put it on the right-hand page with the other family phrases. I want to keep the wording exactly how you said it.
Good. Don't lose that one.
I won't. I flagged it next to the poem draft from last week so I can come back to both.
Baby, they asked me who used to carry that long Easter solo when you were little and I said don't make me start naming names.
Please do not revive my child-robe era tonight lol
You knew every entrance before the piano even got there. Stood by the altos cutting your eyes at folks who came in late.
That part is unfortunately true. Mrs. Henderson had us ready before sunrise.
Put on that baritone singer you liked when I was driving back from campus.
The one that sounds like he came up through Sunday morning somewhere?
Yes ma'am, that one. "Take Me to the Alley" came on and I had to run it back.
He sings like he means every line. Keep that on instead of all that thin little background music.
Baby, did you still want to bring that little recorder Sunday or should I just tell it slow and let you write?
Bring the recorder if you're up for it. I want the part about Great-Granddaddy leaving Louisiana in his own words, not my cleaned-up version.
Mm. Don't let them church up the way he said things either.
I won't. The turns of phrase are part of it.
Can I steal 20 min after class? I'm trying to map the next couple years without living semester to semester.
yes. coffee at 1? bring the messy version.
Messy version = packet deadlines, book proposal notes, and that community project budget draft all fighting each other.
that's three separate piles. we can sort them instead of letting them become one doom blob.
If I can get the packet out this fall and stop treating the project money as one-year scraps, I might finally be able to plan like an adult.
Can you look at slide 12 when you get a second? I redid the whole deck so the policy examples are in blue, discussion prompts in gold, and archival pieces in green.
Opening now. The color split makes way more sense than the old version.
Also your boxes line up finally lol. Are you posting this in the course shell after class?
Yeah, slides + worksheet go up there right after Zoom so the absent students stop emailing me for the link.
You still going to the Sacramento thing Friday?
I don't think so. They still haven't cleared the last campus visit and I'm not fronting train + hotel again.
Yeah don't do that to yourself for a panel.
If it was already on the calendar, fine. But adding another trip while that money is floating somewhere is not happening.
Did you send the workload form before 10? Ours goes through the campus chapter, not the chair.
Yep, sent it last night. I attached the class cap numbers and office hour total.
Good. They pushed back for Priya after she showed the extra sections.
That’s what I’m hoping. I’m not trying to do another term where the memo says one thing and the actual load is something else.
Did you ever post the student mural photos?
Yeah, put them in my IG story this morning. That's where people actually see the art stuff.
Makes sense. I saw the flyer there before the department email did.
Exactly. Campus/community people live there way more than anywhere else now.
Coffee after your 4:30? I need five minutes to complain about the rubric situation.
Yes. And I need to steal your brain on the discussion section that went sideways.
Deal. Library Coffee Bean?
Perfect. 4:45 there.
You still coming by after class to look at those student drafts?
Can't tonight — I already told Marcus I'd meet him at Rose Park.
The board game café era continues?
Not that kind of board. Just coffee and him trying to punish my bad opening habits again.
You looked offended by the stairs to the third floor today.
Yesterday morning was leg day and campus has declared war on me.
Then stop pretending you're 19 when you load the bar.
Rude and accurate.
Did you ever log off or are you still rewriting comments for people at 9 pm
Still at it. My chest has been tight since that department email and now I'm rereading everything like it'll save me.
Close the laptop for ten minutes. Water, food, shower, then pick the three things that actually have to happen tonight.
Yeah. I did the 4 o'clock call yesterday for exactly this reason and apparently still need the sibling version.
Correct. Professional version at 4, annoying little sister version now. Eat something.
You already out?
yeah, meeting the beach lot crew now
Still dark. Keep the blinking light on and text when you're back.
home. We did the PCH stretch and back.
You make it home alright last night?
Yeah, got in a little after 10. Legs are reminding me I'm not 19.
Stretch before you go out there acting young.
Noted. I only went because they had enough people this time.
You coming Sunday or resting up?
Coming, just not trying to do a lot of stairs if I can help it.
Park in the back then. Less up and down.
Appreciate it. Been doing the little band routine at home so it's settling down.
Did you ever set that thing up so money moves out on payday before you can mess with it
Yeah it goes the same day as the deposit now
Good. Makes it easier to leave it alone.
Exactly. I'm still only sitting at a little under 3 months though. Trying to push it to 6.
Baby, did you ever figure out those judges on that long page?
Still working through them. I printed the county guide and opened the candidate statements side by side.
Good. I don't like filling in bubbles blind.
Same. I'm marking notes tonight and can call you tomorrow after class if you want to go through the local races together.
Did you end up going to the reading last night or did grading win?
I went. Stayed after for a set two doors down and walked back through Elm with the camera.
Productive procrastination.
Got a good one of the man outside Page Against the Machine stacking the dollar carts under the neon. Put a few up before I got home.
Grandma, when I come by Sunday can I bring the little recorder again?
If you ask before you turn it on, yes.
Always. I want to practice the question flow before I try it overseas this summer.
Then stop interrupting the good parts and let people take the long road to the story.
Noted. Also making a list of names and places to ask about once I'm there.
Grandma, if I make it to New Orleans this spring, can I bring the recorder and ask you about the branch that left before everybody settled in Long Beach?
You can, but don't rush me through it. Start with your great-aunt Odessa and write the church name down this time.
Deal. I want to match your version with what I can find while I'm there.
Grandma, do you still remember the story about Great-Aunt Reenie leaving Lake Charles and getting off the train here with only one suitcase?
Baby of course I do. She said California looked too bright and too big, and she kept that church hat box on her lap the whole ride.
Can I call tomorrow and record you telling it again? My students really locked in when we talked about how people carry a whole world in one story.
Yes, but don't make me sound fancy. I'm just telling it how I heard it.
You still coming by Sunday? I found that old church hat box.
Yep. Also got a nice one of the man outside the pawn shop on Anaheim with that long shadow across the wall.
Mm. Long as you didn't step into traffic trying to get it.
No traffic acrobatics. I waited by the bus bench until he hit the light.
Baby, did you write down what I told you about your great-aunt running that church fish fry in the rain?
Yeah, I caught the line about her shoes filling with water and her still not missing a beat.
Good. That's the part that makes it breathe.
It's in the dotted notebook already. Ended up turning into half a page after your call.
If you're free next Thursday, Bel Canto Books is doing one of their back-room readings again.
The tiny room with the folding chairs?
Yep. I turned alerts on for them after missing the last one.
Tempting. Send me the link if it doesn't sell out first.
Sending now. Starts at 7, usually over by 8:30.
You still coming to the reading at Page Against the Machine tonight or did grading win
Coming, but only because I got the comments done before 4 and packed tomorrow's class already
lol your version of spontaneity is a fully prepped tote bag
Correct. Once the bag is packed I can enjoy myself like a normal person
See you at 7. Bring one of your shorter pieces if they open the list
You disappeared right after office hours. You okay?
Yeah. Just sat in the car for a while and wrote for ten minutes before driving home.
The kind nobody gets to red-pen?
Exactly that kind.
Good. Keep that one away from the LMS.
You coming by later today or are you doing your long loop first?
Long loop first. Heading out at 6:15 so I'll be back with plenty of time.
Fine. Eat something before you go and text me when you're back inside.
You still coming Sunday or did school eat your whole week again?
I’m coming. I’ve just been on campus four days straight and still have another stack to get through tomorrow.
Then don’t show up tired and empty. Eat first.
Trying. By the time I add class prep, office hours, meetings, and the grading, it turns into basically my whole week.
Did you ever figure out where your money was disappearing last month
yeah. I matched the card charges against the sheet and it was mostly takeout + too many little Target runs
Little runs add up fast
for real. the app made it obvious once I stopped guessing
You still coming Sunday or buried in papers again
Coming. I just have to get through a stack of response essays tonight.
That school job got you reading everybody's thoughts for free.
Not free, thankfully. Still weird being the one writing comments instead of turning them in.
Better side of the desk. Your grandma still talks about that hood and your mama cried all through it.
You coming Sunday before tipoff?
Yeah. I'll get there early if Grandma still wants help with the old photo boxes.
She pulled out the church program from Orange, and that picture of Big Walter in his Army uniform.
Bet. I still want to scan the reunion booklet too. Half the captions are just "cousin from Baton Rouge" and nobody wrote down the years.
You still coming tomorrow after church? I'm making the chicken and rice.
Yeah, I'll head over a little after 2.
Good. Your dad asked if you were staying long enough for the Lakers game.
Tell him yes unless grading runs late. Need me to pick up anything first?
Just yourself. And don't show up hungry at 5 after saying 2.
Can you do the ruthless sister thing for 2 min. My head is doing the too-many-tabs thing.
Yep. Text me the 3 things that actually have to happen tonight. Real things, not your whole semester.
1) email Alina back 2) put clothes in washer 3) set out notes for tomorrow.
Good. Do those, eat something with actual protein, then phone face down. No doom-scroll marathon.
Copy. I already blocked 8-8:45 tomorrow for a ride so I don't start the day buzzing.
There he is. Tiny list, bike, sleep. Report back after food.
I just got through the stack from my 101 sections. Half of them can spot a strong sentence now, but integrating quotes is still chaos.
That's still a win. Are you doing the color-code trick again next week?
Yeah, and Monday I'm pivoting to the unit on reading film clips and ads as texts, so maybe they'll see context before they start dropping random evidence.
Honestly that usually helps. Once they realize an image can be read line by line, the page stops feeling so mysterious.
Morning Gran. Do you still have the photo from the church picnic by Bixby Park, the one with Uncle Leon in the white hat?
I do. In the blue album. Why you need that old thing today?
My students are mapping family movement through the city, and I told them memory sits in ordinary places too, not just downtown plaques.
That picnic mattered. Folks came from all over and still called this home by sunset.
Exactly. Can I swing by after lunch and scan that page if you're up for it?
Tomorrow got away from me, so I split it into three columns: must happen / can slide / ignore.
lol there he is. Did you also color-code it
Only two colors. I put Lillian's pickup at 10, library hour at 1, and dinner with y'all at 6 so nothing drifts.
As long as you also put breakfast on this masterpiece
you up already??
heading out. sun's not even pretending yet
lol your little dawn meetup again?
yep. beach path start. back before first class stuff
fine. eat something after and don't just do coffee
You coming by Sunday before the game or later?
Later. Maya talked me into meeting her for a late brunch first.
Alright. Just drive straight over after and don’t make it an all-day thing.
It won’t be. I’m eating, hanging out a bit, probably one drink max, then heading your way.
You get that light fixed
Yep. Did it the next morning.
Good. Keep doing what you do if you get stopped. Wheel, voice steady, tell them every move before you make it.
Always. Second time taught me not to move too fast for anything.
If you're coming by Sunday, do you want me to wash those bright jerseys with your things or are you using them again Friday morning?
Using one again Friday. I'll bring the pile Sunday.
Okay. Hang them up then, don't leave them in the car.
Already did. Learned that lesson.
Are you coming by tonight to drop off Grandma's pharmacy receipt?
Can do tomorrow after class instead. I'm heading to the gym in a bit.
Late again?
Just for an hour or so if enough guys show up.
Pastor Reed said if you come Sunday, stand near the mic with the men on the last hymn. He remembers you still know how to slide into the part without a lot of fuss.
That man has a long memory.
You spent too many years in that choir loft for people to forget. Just wear something decent and get there before processional.
I'll be there early.
Did you save the voice note from Grandma about the South Carolina branch or was that only on your phone
Saved it. She did the whole chain from her grandfather down to Uncle Reggie and doubled back because she remembered one marriage got skipped.
Lol of course she caught her own omission.
I'm putting dates on all of them this time so we stop arguing at Thanksgiving.
Random sibling nag: did you make that mouth appointment yet
Nope. One place said exam + pictures would be almost $300, so I closed the tab.
rude. Try the community clinic list I sent.
I will after payday.
Family dinner got moved up btw. You coming by tonight or no
Not tonight. I already said yes to the gym run if enough people showed
Look at you being recruited lol
Recruitment is a strong word. More like they needed one more
Did you end up going Saturday?
Yep. Quick in and out.
Any weird side effects or are you alive
Alive. Sore arm, that's it.
Love that for you. Auntie was asking me if those clinic shots are "safe."
Tell her to read the CDC page or ask her doctor. I'm not doing the cousin-group-chat research method.
You disappearing tomorrow after work or are you letting us feed you by the water like every year
I can be there by 6:30 if traffic isn't awful
Perfect. Also mom already started the "you came early and made everybody lose sleep" speech
She tells it like I personally scheduled myself before sunrise
In Long Beach no less, so she gets extra dramatic every time we pass Ocean
Mom sent me that picture of us on the Long Beach porch after your 16th birthday dinner. I look about nine.
You were mad because Dad made you hold the cake level.
And because you got the front room that year and I got stuck by the laundry nook.
Worth it for exactly one year until mom started using my room to stack church program boxes.
Port guys are doing that lunchtime rally Friday. You going by there or straight to campus?
Going by for a bit. They changed schedules again and want everyone to act grateful.
Just don't miss your class.
I won't. I'm leaving campus right after office hours. Also dropping those clinic petition sheets with Alina before noon.
Busy man.
Trying to be useful. Folks shouldn't have to pick between a checkup, rent, and groceries.
You driving out to Riverside next week or staying put?
Staying put unless they send the paperwork through first.
Good. No reason to burn gas and rooms waiting on somebody else's office.
Exactly. I'm keeping it local till that clears.
Still coming by Sunday?
Yeah. Keeping it low-key this week after the first-of-month hit.
That apartment number still 1850?
Still 1850.
Alright. Just checking you're not pretending the math changed.
Did you ever figure out whether you can swing the summer library run?
Maybe. I finally have around 1,200 put away, so it's starting to look less fake.
That's real money. Book early before the fares do that evil jump.
I'm checking this weekend. If I can keep housing cheap I can make it work.
Can you take the first 10 minutes of Friday's workshop if traffic is bad? I moved that standing appointment twice already and this was the only slot they had this month.
Yep, I can open and do attendance. Keep the slot.
Thank you. March has been one long clenched jaw.
I know. Go to your thing and don't answer student email from the parking lot.
How'd discussion go?
Way better once they stopped treating the sermon and the novel like separate planets.
lol there it is. What got them there?
Played the kitchen-table recording first, then had them track repeated lines across the speech, the chapter, and the testimony excerpt. Finally clicked that the voice carries across all three.
That's strong. Keep that sequence for the afternoon section.
Did you ever decide whether that trip goes in the grant as interviews, archive days, or both?
Both. I'm trying to show it isn't just me getting on a plane — mornings in the reading room, afternoons with community folks, and notes I can build into the oral history piece next term.
That's much clearer. Put the deliverables in one sentence so the committee can't pretend they missed it.
How did the meeting go
Still processing. Called Maya from the parking lot before I drove anywhere.
Good call. She does the listening part better than most people.
Yeah. She let me run through the whole thing without turning it into a checklist.
Want to grab tacos after class tomorrow or are you doing your usual cook-at-home reset?
Home reset. But even that has gotten ridiculous lately.
How bad?
I bought decent parmesan, mushrooms, and greens for pasta and it was basically restaurant math by the time I checked out.
The curse of wanting the good version of things.
The clinic paper says $400 before they schedule the dental work. Don’t you go rearranging your whole month over me.
I’m not rearranging the whole month. I can put it on my card and clear it from my reserve the same day if they need it.
Only if your own bills are already handled.
They are. Let me call them first and see what they actually need up front.
Baby, the choir from Macedonia is singing at New Hope on Sunday evening. You taking me or is your mama?
I can take you. If I go this weekend too that's my full month quota in one stretch lol
Nothing wrong with extra. Be outside by 5:10 and don't rush me.
5:10, got it.
Baby are you calling tonight or are you still at that desk?
Still at the desk. I left campus around 6 and I’m finishing comments now.
That sounds like two jobs.
During the term it kind of is. Most weeks land somewhere in the high 40s once everything’s counted.
Did you ever frame the picture from your ceremony or is it still leaning on the wall
Still leaning. I used the frame money on books for this survey class.
Mmhm. You worked too long for that paper and walk not to put it up.
I know. I'll handle it after campus today.
For the passport packet, I found your hospital keepsake card in the file box. St. Mary Medical Center, Long Beach, 1999. Do you want me to leave it out for Sunday?
Yes please. I only need the details from it in case the copy I have is too faint.
Okay. I also put your old school records back in the same folder since every address on them is here.
Amazing. The whole paper trail really said Long Beach and nearby only.
Church picnic sign-up closes today. I put you down for one lunch unless you tell me otherwise.
One is right.
And you can help with the little ones during cleanup since your hands won't be full.
That works. I'll stack chairs and keep juice boxes off the white tablecloths.
If your lease paper came, don't leave it buried in that stack by the table.
It came yesterday. I looked it over this morning.
Same place already this long. Time moves.
I know. This is the third one for this unit.
Then read every line before you sign anything.
Do you need me to drop off that container tonight or tomorrow?
Tomorrow is better. I’ll still be on campus late and then it’s barely a few minutes back home.
All right. I can swing by after work if you’re over by the traffic circle side.
Yep, same apartment. Easy turn from the university.
You sound tired. Are you still coming by Sunday?
Yeah. I just need to get to bed early Friday so I can ride at sunrise Saturday.
Good. You are easier to be around when you do that before the day starts pulling on you.
Exactly. It clears the static.
Are you hiding from grading tonight or pretending to be productive
Little of both. I blocked off 6:30 with Marcus at Confidential Coffee.
The tiny black-and-white war on the café table again?
Yes, and this time I'm not hanging my rook because I got distracted by the espresso machine.
Did you ever finish your ballot homework for the special election thing
Yep. I used half my lunch comparing who actually wants more housing built and who keeps doing the same tough-on-everyone script.
lol ballot homework is such a you phrase
I just want people who won't treat the budget like cops first, library later.
Okay yes that tracks completely
You still doing dinner at your place tomorrow or did grading ruin your life again
Dinner still on. I'm making jambalaya tonight so tomorrow is easy.
Save me a bowl if you're doing the good version and not the dry sad one.
I have enough rice and frozen shrimp. It'll be fine.
You coming over here after dinner or are you doing your usual silent apartment night?
Staying in. I finally got the place quiet and I'm not giving that up tonight.
lol fair. also I left my charger by your couch last time. don't let it disappear into the void.
Nothing's eating it except me forgetting where I put it. It's just me in here.
Did you ever get groceries or are you still surviving on teacher chaos
Not a full run yet. I’m stretching what’s here till next paycheck.
What does stretching mean exactly
Bean bowls, lentils, rice, sautéed greens. Pretty much rotating the same cast.
Okay that’s at least real food. Add hot sauce and pretend it’s intentional.
Your voice memo was correct, I did in fact need to log off and eat
I know. What was dinner
leftover rice and those trader joe's dumplings
acceptable. send proof of vegetable tomorrow
Did you ever come down from today or are you still pacing holes in the floor
Came down. Wrote a page and stopped replaying the meeting.
A page page or your little broken-line thing
Broken-line thing. Not for anybody. Just needed to get it out of my head.
Then that counts. Sleep after, not more spiraling.
You still up or did grading finally release you
Still up but I quit the comments for the night.
good. no more staring at Canvas. do one page in your little notebook and go to bed.
Already did. Three short lines and then a paragraph about how today felt.
excellent. tiny page, brush teeth, sleep.
You left that little black camera bag in my truck again.
My bad. Is the 50 in there too?
I don't know your gear names. One bag, one extra glass thing, bunch of receipts.
Please keep it inside. I had it with me after walking Ocean and Alamitos before class.
You ever get that raise issue sorted out?
Mostly. Payroll said it has to match the new step sheet first, then they’ll backdate the difference.
Good. Always get it in writing when they owe you.
Already emailed. The rep told me not to let it sit because the deadline for filing is this month.
You still coming by Sunday or buried in papers again
Coming by after I finish this budget narrative.
The one you been working on with the neighborhood folks?
Yeah. Trying to make it longer than a one-summer thing this time. Also polishing materials for jobs where they don't make you re-audition every few months.
Good. Build something that lasts.
Still want me to look at that rear brake this weekend?
Yeah if you're around Saturday. I'm rolling out at 6:15 again, but I can stop by after I clean up.
Come after. No point messing with it when you're half asleep.
Coffee before the 10?
Yes, but I'm getting to campus early to do those wall sits and step-downs first.
You and your extremely specific pre-coffee rituals
If I skip them, the front of my left knee complains all day.
Can you swap my office hour on June 18 if the department signs off?
Maybe. Is this the West Africa plan finally becoming real?
Trying to make it real. I found a place in Accra that could connect me with people doing recorded family-story projects.
Then yes, send me the dates early and I'll cover one slot if needed.
Thank you. I'm building the budget now and trying not to look at airfare every ten minutes.
Coffee after class or are you booked all afternoon?
Can't today. I have my 3:30 check-in with DeShawn, then the library room.
The Thursday crew?
Yeah. DeShawn got into Dominguez Hills, and I'm trying to help him compare packages before he commits anywhere.
That's huge. Tell him to make the schools show every fee, not just tuition.
Exactly. And I promised Amina's aunt I'd look over the housing form too since nobody in their house has had to decode that stuff before.
You survive the Saturday clipboard life?
Barely. Two people were great, one guy told me campuses are full of 'indoctrination' and I needed to hear him out.
lol and did you give him your patient teacher face
For like 30 seconds. Then I said I’m not spending my Saturday helping people who want to cut Pell, gut tenant protections, and call it freedom.
Did you protect Friday morning or did campus steal it again
Protected it. I finally have a real outline instead of twenty anxious side files.
What’s the spine now
How the stuff on the syllabus talks to what elders carry and what the neighborhood keeps even when nobody archives it.
That is much clearer. Keep that sentence taped over your desk and stop trying to make it sound like a committee wrote it.
Did you end up posting the workshop flyer everywhere
Not everywhere. LinkedIn for the campus crowd, Instagram story for students who already follow me.
Facebook I'll toss to family later so my mom can share it.
And the chaos site
Maybe once, if at all. I don't hang out there long anymore.
You surviving the committee circus
Barely. I'm stopping by El Dorado on the way back so I don't carry that meeting into tonight.
Smart. Better there than replaying everybody's nonsense at 11 pm.
Did you ever find the article citation from the meeting, or is it gone forever
Found it. I had tucked it in the margin next to Tuesday's lecture notes and the March deadlines spread.
Of course you did. Your paper system is mysterious but effective.
It's only mysterious if you ignore the index page.
You survived office hours?
Barely. Walking to the car with Gregory Porter on because I need something that sounds grounded.
Your reset music always sounds like somebody in a good suit telling the room to breathe.
Exactly. I need that choir-adjacent weight more than anything shiny right now.
You vanished after that meeting. You okay?
Yeah, just irritated. Went for a walk instead of opening any apps.
Wise. The internet would only make you madder.
Exactly. I'd rather text two actual people than toss it into the crowd.
Baby, did you save that picture from the family picnic with all your matching shirts on?
Yeah lol the one from Juneteenth at Silverado Park? I have it.
Send me that and the one of your granddaddy by the barbecue pit. Your auntie wants them for the memory board.
Sending both now. I'll label them better this time so we stop losing who's who.
You free for a quick call later? Also I’m going by the East Village Art Walk after campus.
Call me after you finish looking around. You always find some trumpet player on a corner.
That is exactly the plan. Hoping the bookstore table is out too.
Then send me the best one, not ten blurry people crossing the street.
You coming by tonight or are you out?
Out for a bit. A trumpet trio is playing at that little room on 4th, and I wanted to catch the early set.
You do like those tucked-away places.
They're better when you can actually hear every breath and page turn.
Alright baby, call me tomorrow.
Can I call you tomorrow afternoon? I want to hear that story again about Great-Granddaddy leaving Louisiana. I'm opening next week's class with movement stories and memory.
You can call me after lunch, baby. I will tell it right, not the short version you always try to use.
Please do. The students were locked in today when we talked about the porch scene and whose voice gets carried forward.
Then tell them stories travel with people, even when everything else gets left behind.
You coming by tomorrow or working all day?
Coming by. I can get there around 3.
Alright. TV's yours if you want the Dodgers game. Your mom said bring that folder for Lillian too.
Got it. I'll bring the folder and stay for dinner.
You parking by mom's or meeting there later?
Later. Need coffee first and a shower.
Respectable. Bring the good hot sauce if you remember.
Road by the church is crowded already.
Noted. I'll come the back way.
Projector in 214 is acting dramatic again.
Of course it is. HDMI roulette?
Exactly. Bring your adapter if you have it.
Rain supposed to hit tonight?
Looks like just drizzle. Wind more than anything.
Take a jacket. Mornings still got teeth.
Already in the car.
Did you ever find my blue pen
Under the couch somehow.
That couch eats office supplies.
You left your water bottle here Sunday.
Classic. Keep it till next time.
Baby, your aunt made too much pound cake again.
This family refuses restraint.
Come get two slices before your uncle does.
Your mom packed you oranges btw.
Of course she did.
Check the side pocket of your bag.
Faculty lounge coffee tastes especially haunted today.
That means they made a fresh pot.
If you stop at the store, get foil.
Regular or heavy duty?
Heavy. The cheap one tears if you look at it.
710 moving decent right now.
A rare civic miracle.
What are you wearing to the wedding
Blue shirt, dark jacket, pretending I planned ahead.
Miracles continue.
Bring me the soft crackers if you stop anywhere.
Saltines or the buttery ones?
Buttery. The plain ones taste like cardboard apologies.
Maintenance ever show up?
Not yet. I moved the desk though.
Good. They'll arrive at 11:59 on purpose.
Still calling after class or did life happen
Still calling. Give me twenty.
Cool, I'm microwaving leftovers anyway.
Wind is trying to steal everybody's papers today.
One syllabus already died a heroic death.
Need me to hold that step stool for you Sunday?
Yeah probably. Closet shelf is annoying.
Your aunt keeps calling my phone by mistake.
You answer?
Only once. She was looking for your mother.
Do you want leftovers or are you set tonight?
Set tonight. Save them for Dad's midnight raid.
Parking awful over there?
Like the campus is hosting twelve secret events.
Thoughts and prayers.
I found your blue tin under the mail stack.
That is exactly where I did not look.
Happy Thursday, birthday child.
Please do not call me that in public.
No promises.
Want me to grab ice for tonight
Yeah, one bag should do it.
How was the water-view dinner
Good. Dad complained about parking, so tradition survived.
Excellent. Real family atmosphere.
You make it through today alive?
Mostly. Printer fought me, then gave up.
Don't forget my folder tomorrow.
By the door already.
Good baby.
Do not bring another giant container home.
No promises if the cobbler appears.
